name: print-social-novavista-lime-post-with-teal-target-rings
title: Novavista lime post with teal headline and bold concentric target rings
whatItIs: A square lime post with a teal N logo, teal headline 'Empower Your Business with Targeted Marketing Solutions.', faint arc lines, and a big teal concentric-ring target sliced diagonally in the bottom-right corner.
whatItMeans: Fresh and punchy; the target literally illustrates 'targeted' with pure geometry.
techniques: Turn the headline's key word into a geometric symbol.
Slice a shape diagonally for tension.
Use a two-colour palette with strong contrast.

vocabulary.definition: A graphic that literally shows a word's meaning.
